_doc: build 29 Forge characters: THE one place that says which finished model each playable Forge character is built from. To drop in a newer model (the Phase A3 heads, or any later Forge pass), point its "source" at the new .blend (exported by export_char.py) or at a folder holding lod0.glb and lod1.glb, then run tools/forge_chars/install.sh <key> on the farm and re-export the pck. "playable" false = its rig did not pass add_hero.sh's clip gate: kept here with the reason, never installed, never pickable (fight.gd FORGE_CAST and features/waleui/characters.ts list the playable ones). Build 31: a character published in the Forge can be named by "forge_element" (its element id; "forge_api" picks the server) instead of "source": install.sh pulls its published lods with forge_pull_char.py. Characters the catalogue marks playable (role hero) need no entry here at all: the app lists them at run time (features/waleui/characters.ts catalogueCharacters).

forge_courier.name: Courier
forge_courier.head_pass: A3 (18 Nov: generated head texture + landmark-aligned face; no blue nose streak). A2 was ~/forge-artist/bakeoff2/phaseA2/chars/courier/var_lens20/final.blend

forge_bram.name: Bram
forge_bram.a3: ~/forge-artist/bakeoff2/phaseA2/chars/bram/a3/final_final.blend (better head; same rig tears, 1.6 % idle / 3.4 % jog, so still not playable)
forge_bram.previous_why: add_hero.sh gate: rig tears in every clip (idle 1.6 %, jog 3.6 %, worst 7.5 % of triangles past 2.5x; gate 0.5 %), mostly the outfit at the armpits, the belt pouches beside the hands and the crotch
forge_bram.head_pass: A3 head; garment weights redone (reweight.py, Forge commit a435006): hands rigid, contact relabelled, A-pose 35 deg baked
forge_bram.known_flaws: build 30 hole check: small see-through gaps at the right armpit and through the belt pouches in overhead swings, thin fins at the glove edges, a few loose specks above the head; visible only up close, not at the game camera

forge_mei.name: Mei
forge_mei.why: build 31: not baked; she comes from the Forge catalogue at run time (element 157ff388 v2, published with her fight kit). This entry can still bake her as an offline fallback: install.sh forge_mei pulls the published lods.

forge_catboy.name: Cat-Boy
